recommendation.summary: Signal extraction works deterministically and filters out >94% of keyword noise, proving technical feasibility. However, commercially we recommend IMPROVE before scaling to 20+ boards: (1) High-growth tech companies often hire internal AI/Ops builders to automate workflows in-house rather than buying external tools, so we should shift the target board list toward mid-market, less technical organizations; (2) Deduplicate multi-region job postings by default; and (3) Score Direct Manual Execution roles separately from Internal Automation Mandate roles.
